title: ExpertReviewDecidedEvent
description: Domain event: an expert submitted a verdict for an analysis review (KR-019). This event is the GATE: an approving outcome (gate_outcome=APPROVED_PUBLISHED) authorises farmer-facing publication of the result (mission→DELIVERED, dataset→DERIVED_PUBLISHED, map layer served); a rejecting outcome blocks publication and routes the mission to reprocessing. Identifiers are runtime UUIDs (see notes.id_format).

event_id.description: Unique event identifier (platform DomainEvent base — uuid4)

occurred_at.description: When the verdict was submitted (ISO 8601 UTC)

Uuid.description: RFC 4122 UUID (runtime identifier format across platform/worker)

ExpertReviewDecidedData.title: Expert Review Decided Data
ExpertReviewDecidedData.description: Verdict and the resulting publication gate decision.

analysis_result_id.description: Analysis result the verdict applies to

expert_user_id.description: Pseudonymous identifier of the deciding expert (no PII per KR-050/KR-071)

verdict.description: Expert verdict — aligned with worker/expert_feedback.v1 and platform/training_feedback.v1.

gate_outcome.description: Publication gate result derived from the verdict: confirmed/corrected→APPROVED_PUBLISHED (farmer publication authorised); rejected→REJECTED (no publication, mission reprocessed); needs_more_expert→ESCALATED (awaiting another expert, no publication yet).

training_grade.description: Optional training data grade (KR-029). Null when not graded.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for tracing related events

causation_id.description: ID of event/command that caused this event

notes.lifecycle: ACTIVE — uyumlu platform üreticisi mevcut. Platform-expert-portal submit_review (expert_portal.py) bu wire olayını yayınlar (ExpertReviewDecidedV1, expert_gate_events.py → domain.events exchange, routing event.expert.review_decided). In-process ExpertReviewCompleted ayrıca WORM audit için korunur. (SYNC-1 hizalandı 2026-06-15)
notes.gate_semantics: This event is the publication gate. Only gate_outcome=APPROVED_PUBLISHED authorises farmer-facing delivery. REJECTED and ESCALATED keep the result hidden from the farmer.
notes.verdict_mapping: gate_outcome is the REAL N-expert consensus gate decision, NOT a naive per-verdict mapping (avoids premature farmer publication): APPROVED_PUBLISHED only when consensus is complete AND no rejection (mission→DONE, dataset→DERIVED_PUBLISHED); REJECTED when this or a sibling verdict rejects and consensus is complete (mission→EXPERT_REJECTED, no publication); ESCALATED while sibling reviews are still pending OR verdict=needs_more_expert (publication withheld). For the single-reviewer case this collapses to confirmed|corrected→APPROVED_PUBLISHED, rejected→REJECTED, needs_more_expert→ESCALATED.
notes.id_format: Identifiers are RFC 4122 UUID strings to match the running platform wire format (platform DomainEvent base emits str(uuid4)). See analysis_review_requested.v1 notes.id_format.
notes.pii_free: No PII. expert_user_id is a pseudonymous identifier (KR-050/KR-071).
